preconditions.description: K is a positive integer not exceeding the length of S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S consists exclusively of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == orderlyQueue(S, K)[i] for i in range(len(S))) or any(S[i] < orderlyQueue(S, K)[i] for i in range(len(S))) or (len(S) > 0 and S[0] == orderlyQueue(S, K)[0] and any(S[i] < orderlyQueue(S, K)[i] for i in range(1, len(S))))
postconditions.description: The returned string is lexicographically smallest possible after any number of moves, where each move consists of taking one of the first K characters and moving it to the end of the string.
The returned string has the same length as the input string S.
